messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — SPA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (v2, tracked). Headline points from our side: cap down to £8.5m (20% of EV); basket up to £637,500; claims period reduced to 18 months; and Patricia's non-compete to 24 months. We've left the retention in for now but reserve the W&I point. Happy to talk it through this week.

Oliver
